events.name: Bash
events.head: Survey probe-library script for poll check
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; wc -l app/scripts/probe-library.mjs; grep -n "poll\|lx-room\|goto\|BASE\|argv\|function \|check(" app/scripts/probe-library.mjs | head -60

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find poll category and library URL params
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app/src; grep -rn "live-polls\|giveaway-diagnostic" --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx . | grep -v "data/" | head; grep -rln "searchParams\|location.hash\|URLSearchParams" components/library app/onboarding/templates 2>/dev/null | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find category ids and URL handling
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app/src; grep -rn "live-polls\|giveaway-diagnostic" lib/examples/categories.ts lib/examples/index.ts | head; grep -n "searchParams\|location.hash\|URLSearchParams\|replaceState\|cat=\|\"t\"\|get(\"" app/onboarding/templates/templates-client.tsx | head -30

events.text: Reading the library's deep-link handling to point the poll check at a poll view.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run probe against live centre and mirror
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; for u in https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/onboarding/templates/ https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/onboarding/templates/; do echo "== $u"; URL=$u WIDTHS=1440 node scripts/probe-library.mjs 2>&1 | tail -16; done

events.text: Both pass at 1440. Running all four default widths to confirm the whole probe is green.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run full-width probe on centre and mirror
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; (URL=https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/onboarding/templates/ node scripts/probe-library.mjs > /tmp/pl-c.txt 2>&1; echo "exit $?" >> /tmp/pl-c.txt) & (URL=https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/onboarding/templates/ node scripts/probe-library.mjs > /tmp/pl-m.txt 2>&1; echo "exit $?" >> /tmp/pl-m.txt) & wait; for f in /tmp/pl-c.txt /tmp/pl-m.txt; do echo "== $f"; grep -E "✗|^—|PASS|failure|exit" $f; done
